# Mission Meets Tech

> Federal health IT intelligence: contract opportunities, market intel, IDIQ vehicles, agency profiles, and capture analysis for people who pursue government work. Written by Mary Womack.

Mission Meets Tech (missionmeetstech.com) publishes a newsletter, a podcast, and a set of premium intelligence tools. Premium members with the Agent Access add-on can connect their own AI agent to their live MMT data through a read-only API.

## Agent Access API

The API lets an AI agent read your federal-contracting intelligence so it can answer from your real pipeline instead of guessing. Bearer-token auth. MMT Premium plus the Agent Access add-on is required.

- [API catalog](https://missionmeetstech.com/api/v1): machine-readable index of every endpoint, scope, auth detail, and rate limit
- [OpenAPI spec](https://missionmeetstech.com/api/v1/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the read endpoints
- [MCP server](https://missionmeetstech.com/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint for assistants that "add a connector" (Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, ChatGPT). Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC. OAuth sign-in via [protected-resource metadata](https://missionmeetstech.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource) and [authorization server metadata](https://missionmeetstech.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
- [Set up Agent Access](https://missionmeetstech.com/premium/ai-integrations/): mint a token or connect an assistant, pick what your agent can see, revoke any time

Start at the API catalog for scripting (bearer token), or add the MCP server as a connector for a click-to-connect sign-in. Both are read-only.
